lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਸੂਖੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookhaa te sukh oopajahi sookhee hovahi dookh ||
lines.translation: Out of pain, pleasure is produced, and out of pleasure comes pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jit mukh too saalaaheeahi tit mukh kaisee bhookh ||3||
lines.translation: That mouth which praises You - what hunger could that mouth ever suffer? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak moorakh ek too avar bhalaa saisaar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, you alone are foolish; all the rest of the world is good.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jit tan naam na oopajai se tan hohi khuaar ||4||2||
lines.translation: That body in which the Naam does not well up - that body becomes miserable. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਉਚਰੇ ਸੰਕਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai kaaran bed brahamai uchare sa(n)kar chhodee maaiaa ||
lines.translation: For His sake, Brahma uttered the Vedas, and Shiva renounced Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jai kaaran sidh bhae udaasee devee maram na paaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: For His sake, the Siddhas became hermits and renunciates; even the gods have not realized His Mystery. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa man saachaa mukh saachaa kaheeai tareeai saachaa hoee ||
lines.translation: O Baba, keep the True Lord in your mind, and utter the Name of the True Lord with your mouth; the True Lord will carry you across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dusaman dookh na aavai neRai har mat paavai koee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Enemies and pain shall not even approach you; only a rare few realize the Wisdom of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਪਵਣੈ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan bi(n)b pavanai kee baanee teen naam ke daasaa ||
lines.translation: Fire, water and air make up the world; these three are the slaves of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਤਸਕਰ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵਹਿ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਕੋਟ ਪੰਚਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: te tasakar jo naam na levahi vaasahi kot pa(n)chaasaa ||2||
lines.translation: One who does not chant the Naam is a thief, dwelling in the fortress of the five thieves. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਫਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko ek karai cha(n)giaaee man chit bahut baphaavai ||
lines.translation: If someone does a good deed for someone else, he totally puffs himself up in his conscious mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਤੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ete gun eteeaa cha(n)giaaeeaa dei na pachhotaavai ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord bestows so many virtues and so much goodness; He does not ever regret it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh saalaahan tin dhan palai naanak kaa dhan soee ||
lines.translation: Those who praise You gather the wealth in their laps; this is Nanak's wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ਕਹੈ ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je ko jeeu kahai onaa kau jam kee talab na hoee ||4||3||
lines.translation: Whoever shows respect to them is not summoned by the Messenger of Death. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai roop naahee jaat naahee naahee mukh maasaa ||
lines.translation: One who has no beauty, no social status, no mouth, no flesh

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mile nira(n)jan paaiaa terai naam hai nivaasaa ||1||
lines.translation: - meeting with the True Guru, he finds the Immaculate Lord, and dwells in Your Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਧੂ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: audhoo sahaje tat beechaar ||
lines.translation: O detached Yogi, contemplate the essence of reality,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa te phir na aavahu saisaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and you shall never again come to be born into the world. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਚਿ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai karam naahee dharam naahee naahee such maalaa ||
lines.translation: One who does not have good karma or Dharmic faith, sacred rosary or mala

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੰਨਹੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: siv jot ka(n)nahu budh paaee satiguroo rakhavaalaa ||2||
lines.translation: - through the Light of God, wisdom is bestowed; the True Guru is our Protector. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਕਬਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai barat naahee nem naahee naahee bakabaaee ||
lines.translation: One who does not observe any fasts, make religious vows or chant

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gat avagat kee chi(n)t naahee satiguroo phuramaaee ||3||
lines.translation: - he does not have to worry about good luck or bad, if he obeys the Command of the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai aas naahee niraas naahee chit surat samajhaaee ||
lines.translation: One who is not hopeful, nor hopeless, who has trained his intuitive consciousness

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ta(n)t kau param ta(n)t miliaa naanakaa budh paaee ||4||4||
lines.translation: - his being blends with the Supreme Being. O Nanak, his awareness is awakened. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kaa kahiaa dar paravaan ||
lines.translation: What he says is approved in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bikh a(n)mrit dui sam kar jaan ||1||
lines.translation: He looks upon poison and nectar as one and the same. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa kaheeai sarabe rahiaa samaai ||
lines.translation: What can I say? You are permeating and pervading all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh varatai sabh teree rajaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever happens, is all by Your Will. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragatee jot chookaa abhimaan ||
lines.translation: The Divine Light shines radiantly, and egotistical pride is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur deeaa a(n)mrit naam ||2||
lines.translation: The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal mahi aaiaa so jan jaan ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, one's birth is approved,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saachee daragah paavai maan ||3||
lines.translation: if one is honored in the True Court. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਅਕਥ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahanaa sunanaa akath ghar jaai ||
lines.translation: Speaking and listening, one goes to the Celestial Home of the Indescribable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kathanee badanee naanak jal jaai ||4||5||
lines.translation: Mere words of mouth, O Nanak, are burnt away. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit neer giaan man majan athasath teerath sa(n)g gahe ||
lines.translation: One who bathes in the Ambrosial Water of spiritual wisdom takes with him the virtues of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੋੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur upades javaahar maanak seve sikh sou khoj lahai ||1||
lines.translation: The Guru's Teachings are the gems and jewels; the Sikh who serves Him searches and finds them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur samaan teerath nahee koi ||
lines.translation: There is no sacred shrine equal to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sar sa(n)tokh taas gur hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru encompasses the ocean of contentment. ||1||Pause||
